calibration_rulings.title: list2.lead: the bare «نخلستان» for 'the oasis', or the oasis named («الاحساء کے نخلستان»), given that the lead is also the meta description?
calibration_rulings.binds: list2.lead; any later interface lead of the same build.
calibration_rulings.ruling: A. An interface lead that says 'the oasis' as its source does keeps the bare «نخلستان» on two conditions. (1) The same sentence names «الاحساء». (2) N47-the-oasis-on-a-page-that-has-not-named-it is met on the page, in its own words: «الاحساء کے نخلستان» / «الاحساء کا نخلستان» stands in at least one field of the rendered page, including one behind a tap (a closed group, a collapsed card). On this index that field is the bird-garden card «الاحساء کے نخلستان کے ماحول میں ایک باغ،». It sits in the farms group, which is closed when the page opens, and it counts. Condition (1) never stands in for (2). B (the oasis named in the lead, 'Al-Ahsa' at the close becoming 'here') is not needed here.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read. A lead with the bare «نخلستان» names «الاحساء» in the same sentence, AND N47 holds for the page: at least one field of the rendered page, including one behind a tap, names «الاحساء کے نخلستان» / «الاحساء کا نخلستان». What is visible at first view is not the test. If no field of the rendered page names it, the lead takes B's form.
calibration_rulings.ruled_by: Judge round2, b12-ui (round 4), 2026-10-15; record corrected by the judge's addendum to that round

calibration_rulings.title: list2.lead: the closing clause for 'taste the bounty of Al-Ahsa' / «ذُق خيرات الأحساء».
calibration_rulings.ruling: A: «… اور الاحساء کی نعمتوں کا ذائقہ لیں۔». Both read wordings are contested by one reader, so the tie is broken by the kind of fault. A's fault is register. D's fault is meaning: it brought in a gift brought back from a place, which neither source carries, and lost the abundance of 'bounty' / «خيرات». The dictionary confirms the reader on that, and the fence outranks fluency. B is withdrawn because of the idiom. C is not taken: «چکھنا» with the abstract «نعمتیں» as object is the English carried over (stage 2), and no reader has read it, so it stays on record as unread. D is withdrawn. A new native wording would have to keep both 'taste' and 'bounty' and be read in place before it replaces A.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader, not machine-read. For a pleasant tasting the line uses neither «مزہ چکھ…» nor «ذائقہ چکھ…». «سوغات» does not render 'bounty' / «خيرات».

calibration_rulings.title: list2.lead: «سوق القیصریہ» bare (P3c-labels: the string is a meta description) or with the running-text form «نامی بازار» (P3c point 2)?
calibration_rulings.binds: list2.lead; every interface string that doubles as a meta description.
calibration_rulings.ruling: A. A string that is both a lead and a meta description follows P3c-labels: the name stands bare; the plain generic stands in the neighbouring line (the h1).
calibration_rulings.guard: Stage checker, as today: no bracket and no Urdu generic next to a name that carries its Arabic generic in such a string.

calibration_rulings.title: list2.lead: «فارموں» bare in running text, or «زرعی فارموں» (N5's label form)?
calibration_rulings.ruling: A. N5's qualifier «زرعی» is owed where «فارم» stands UNQUALIFIED as a label or a list item, as in nav.leisure «بازار، تفریح گاہیں اور زرعی فارم», where two readers read the bare word as the form one fills in. It is not owed where a possessive or an attribute already qualifies the word, because that context fixes the sense. Here «فارموں» is qualified by «نخلستان کے» («نخلستان کے باغوں اور فارموں»), so the bare oblique stands. This is the ground of the approved texts too: «زکی السالم کا فارم», «اسٹرابیری کا فارم», and «… کاشت کرنے والے سب سے بڑے فارموں» on zaki-alsalem-farm. The kind of string (lead, meta description, heading) does not decide it. A string ruled a meta description under N184 is not, by that alone, owed the qualifier. This agrees with N5 and changes none of its forms.
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader: «زرعی» before «فارم» where the word stands unqualified as a label or a list item (N5: nav.leisure, the farm-group label «زرعی فارم اور کھجور کے باغات»). It is not required where a possessive or an attribute qualifies it («… کا فارم», «نخلستان کے … فارموں», «… والے … فارموں»). A bare «فارم» as a label or list item is a finding; a qualified one is not.
calibration_rulings.ruled_by: Judge round2, b12-ui (round 4), 2026-10-15; record corrected by the judge's addendum to that round

calibration_rulings.title: list2.eyebrow: keep «سیاحتی رہنما» (the approved list.eyebrow, live on the sister attractions index) although the reader first read it as a person?
calibration_rulings.binds: list.eyebrow, list2.eyebrow and every later index eyebrow of the same English.
calibration_rulings.ruling: A. The two sister eyebrows stay one string; the cost is charged under nativeness and fit. A rewording, if ever taken, moves list.eyebrow and list2.eyebrow (and their tm.json pairs) together in one interface batch and is read in place; never «گائیڈ». Two readers now, so the cost is real, and a reworded pair is a standing option for a later interface batch (never «گائیڈ»).
calibration_rulings.guard: For the proofreader: an index eyebrow whose English is 'Visit guide' is byte-identical to list.eyebrow; «گائیڈ» is a banned loan (stage checker).
